mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment that may affect semaglutide efficacy and increase GLP-1 agonist adverse effects; semaglutide's gastric effects may alter foscarnet absorption.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood glucose closely; assess for increased GI side effects; ensure adequate hydration during concurrent use.
